title: A hold with no end: a refused out-of-range profile value is kept, so another writer's profile change stays unshown until the person repairs that field, with no sign on the page
evidence: Root fix R13 (triage 2026-11-25): one record-apply hold state that ends on the next profile save that settles, landed or refused (US-34 AC8, R13 PR 2: the relay's `settled` event; useProfileSave no longer skips it on a refused value). HealthTool.record-read-pins.test.tsx US-34 AC8: height 400 left, a remote birthYear 1981 held, then the next save (fixed or refused again) shows it once and keeps the typed height. Follow-up (2026-11-27, US-34 AC13, PR 2218 merged 2026-11-27; ruled option 2, the form alone): a remote change arriving after the refused save was still held until the next edit (test failed on main: Expected 1981, Received 1980). The relay's `arrived` event now carries the form (`free` or `typing`, useProfileSave `profileForm`); only `typing` (an in-range value still to save, or a unit switch) holds. An out-of-range value, refused or half-typed, rides through: a focused "1" keeps its text and focus and the page never writes the box (caret kept). No new phase. Limits: caret proved by no write, not read (number input); US feet and inches untested; not real WebKit
